# Md Nahid Hossain

> Md Nahid Hossain is a Dhaka-based Google Ads manager and conversion tracking specialist helping US and European businesses get more leads and sales.

Md Nahid Hossain (also known as Nahid Hossain) is a Google Ads Manager at Ecomclips (since October 2026) and a Fiverr Pro freelancer. He plans and optimises Google Ads for sales and lead generation, with GA4 and Google Tag Manager conversion tracking at the centre. Before Ecomclips he was Team Lead and Google Ads Project Manager at ScaleUp Ads Agency. He holds a BBA from Govt. Titumir College, University of Dhaka (2020-2025), and Google Ads certifications (Skilluper, Dec 2025). He works directly with clients as a solo freelancer.

## Services

- Google Ads Management: Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Demand Gen, YouTube and Display, run against your cost per lead or sale. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/google-ads-management/)
- Performance Max, Shopping & Merchant Center: E-commerce growth on Shopify and WooCommerce: product feed optimisation, Shopping and Performance Max built on sales value. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/performance-max-shopping/)
- Lead Generation for Local Service Businesses: More calls, forms and booked jobs for dental, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, repair and other local services. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/local-lead-generation/)
- Google Ads Account Audit: A data-led review of structure, search intent, tracking, landing pages, CPA and ROAS, with a prioritised fix list. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/google-ads-audit/)
- Online Conversion Tracking: Google Ads conversion tracking for forms, calls, bookings, purchases, chat and WhatsApp clicks, tested before you rely on it. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/conversion-tracking/)
- Enhanced Conversions (Web & Leads): Enhanced Conversions for web and for leads, so Google Ads can recover more conversions lost to browser and cookie limits. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/enhanced-conversions/)
- Offline Conversion Tracking: Import CRM, call and form-lead outcomes back into Google Ads, so campaigns optimise toward leads that become customers. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/offline-conversion-tracking/)
- Server-Side Tracking (sGTM): Server-side Google Tag Manager for GA4 and Google Ads, for more control over the data your site sends. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/server-side-tracking/)
- GA4 Setup & Reporting: A clean Google Analytics 4 property: key events, e-commerce events, Google Ads linking and reports you can read. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/ga4-setup-reporting/)
- Google Tag Manager Setup: A tidy GTM container with clear tags, triggers and variables for Google Ads, GA4 and other platforms. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/google-tag-manager-setup/)
- Booking System Tracking: Track appointments and bookings across Shopify, Halaxy, WordPress and Webflow booking tools in GA4 and Google Ads. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/booking-system-tracking/)
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO): Landing-page reviews and changes that help more of your paid clicks turn into calls, leads and sales. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/conversion-rate-optimization/)
- YouTube Ads: Video campaigns for low-cost, engaged views first, then subscriber or customer growth. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/youtube-ads/)
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram): Facebook and Instagram campaigns for leads and sales, with the Meta Pixel and Conversions API set up properly. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/meta-ads/)
- Looker Studio Dashboards & Reporting: Clear Looker Studio dashboards for leads, sales, cost per result and ROAS across Google Ads, GA4 and more. (https://nomadnahid.me/services/looker-studio-reporting/)

## Work

- 18 case studies with real account screenshots across e-commerce, dental, electronics repair, hotels, HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, boat repair, real estate, retail, a wellness resort, clinic booking tracking and YouTube channel growth. Examples: an 87x ROAS Performance Max campaign for an online store; 784 dental patient leads in 30 days at $28.51 each; cost per lead cut 52% for an electronics repair shop. Results vary by industry, budget and market.
